mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish: skies are clear over Harriet Park, though the air quality index is slightly elevated at 53. We are currently experiencing a new moon phase, and as we look ahead to the overnight hours, we expect a low of 68 degrees with no rain predicted.

In city news, construction on Highway M begins on August 18, which will involve lane shifts and the closure of the Alliant and Kwik Trip driveway. Also, the Plan Commission will meet on September 8 to discuss the site plan for 201 South Main Street and an initial review for the Sub-Zero project in Liberty Business Park.

Today is packed with trivia, including events at Hop Haus and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, we have a variety of activities ranging from morning yoga at Insight Wellness and the downtown Farmer's Market in the afternoon to evening trivia at The Mill and The Bogey Factory.

The Verona Police Department reported that on Wednesday, August 5, officers apprehended a 37-year-old Madison man at a residence on Whalen Road following a foot pursuit related to a probation violation warrant, which has resulted in an additional charge of failing to comply with officers.
Today's delicious flavor is Chocolate Heath Crunch. The shop is open until 10 PM tonight, so you have plenty of time to stop by for a treat before they close.
